author: agent
objective: Among Italian provincial-capital cities, what is the association between the 2018 annual number of daily PM10 exceedances above 50 µg/m³ and cumulative reported COVID-19 infections during the first Italian wave, adjusted for 2019 population density?

scientific_invariants.research_question: Among Italian provincial-capital cities, what is the association between the 2018 annual number of daily PM10 exceedances above 50 µg/m³ and cumulative reported COVID-19 infections during the first Italian wave, adjusted for 2019 population density?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Cumulative infected individuals in 55 randomly selected Italian provincial-capital cities, measured 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020; Table 6 presents the multivariable model and Table 7 presents pollution-stratified density models.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Outcome ratio per doubling of annual count of daily PM10 exceedances above 50 µg/m³, from log-log OLS coefficient as 2^beta.
principal_variants: Article-supported pollution-stratified density regressions for all three dates
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: Italian provincial-capital cities (article sample N=55; article does not identify the city list in supplied full text)

article_evidence.finding: Sample section specifies 55 randomly selected Italian provincial capitals; data section specifies 2018 annual exceedance days and cumulative infected individuals on 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020; procedure specifies log-log OLS and population density.
Contract target specifies PM10, 2018 exceedance days, 55 Italian provincial-capital cities, and log-log regression with population density.

article_evidence_map.contract_discrepancy: Methods text calls exposure total days exceeding PM10 or ozone limits; Table 6 regression label and supplied target specify PM10. Lock follows fitted-table/contract PM10 formulation. Contract's singular cumulative first-wave outcome is expanded to the three explicit Table 6/Table 7 dates.

execution_design.assignment_method: nearest catalog-discovered PM10 monitor within 100 km of provincial-capital coordinate; retain city-monitor distance
execution_design.exposure_metric: count of observed 2018 daily PM10 means strictly greater than 50 ug/m3
execution_design.daily_aggregation: AERIS normalized daily means; one observed value per city-day from selected monitor
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: per-city annual threshold exceedance count joined to outcomes and density

coverage_policy.threshold_source: No article or source-supported numeric completeness threshold
coverage_policy.evidence: Retain every city with a positive threshold count and report observed days/365; selection is a feasibility subset, not the complete article sample.

execution_design.intended_use: bounded source-substituted log-log OLS reanalysis using independent public monitor data

evidence.finding: Milano and Roma have 670 daily PM10 records in 2018 via AERIS/OpenAQ and daily values support deriving threshold days.
Probe selected one catalog-discovered monitor per city with observed city-monitor distances up to 60.4 km.

amendments.scientific_justification: The locked metric requires a threshold count, so daily observations rather than the annual mean summary will be used. A 100-km search bound produced usable independent records for both feasibility cities; temporal coverage and monitor distances will be retained.
